goal: Prevent transaction deanonymization by fully isolating private broadcasts from regular node peer state
Clean up core peer-to-peer networking by removing complex special cases from connection management
reviewability: Worth reviewing now even with conflicts because the needed rebase on master is mechanical
agreement: Support because isolating broadcasts from node state prevents clearnet correlation leaks (darosior)
Unaddressed objection: relying permanently on DNS seeds creates a single point of failure (vasild)
Unaddressed objection: sending only to IP peers over Tor harms network privacy and lacks fallback (vasild)
Suggests deprecating in-node private broadcast in favor of external broadcast tools or hooks (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because existing private broadcast risks IP linkage and transaction deanonymization via shared node state
Active network adversaries can exploit current peer tracking and connection logic to link transactions
Eliminating these correlation leaks resolves a critical privacy flaw in transaction relay
